claims.quote: the activity, but not the protein level, of an essential DNA repair enzyme, polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase (PNKP), is severely abrogated in both HD and SCA3 resulting in accumulation of double-strand breaks in patients' brain genome.
Supplementation of F2,6BP restored PNKP activity in the nuclear extracts of patients' brain.
Moreover, intracellular delivery of F2,6BP restored both the activity of PNKP and the integrity of transcribed genome in neuronal cells derived from striatum of HD mouse.
supplementing F2,6BP rescued the HD phenotype in Drosophila
